subject: MAP: Technical evaluation milestone — benchmark slate & owners
messages:
From: Sarah Palmer <sarah.palmer@healthpath.com>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.com>
Cc: Carlos Mendez <carlos.m@healthpath.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-demo — technical next steps & MAP

Hi Rohan,

Thanks for the demo earlier — appreciate the runtime walkthrough and examples on cost/latency tradeoffs. Carlos and I chatted after and we agreed the next step we need from Redwood is a short, actionable MAP milestone for the technical evaluation so our engineering team can budget cycles.

Specifically, can you send a draft that includes:
- Milestones & owners for the technical evaluation (who on Redwood & HealthPath own which tasks)
- Concrete success criteria (benchmarks we’ll use to say “pass”) — e.g., latency targets, cost per token, and any model-quality thresholds
- A short model shortlist you plan to test and why
- Dependencies (data, infra access, credentials) and a suggested target close date for the MAP milestone

We’d like something we can share with our platform folks this week.

Thanks,
Sarah Palmer
Director of Product
HealthPath

Date: Fri, 27 Feb 2026 09:30:00 -0800
Subject: MAP: Technical evaluation milestone — benchmark slate & owners

Hi Sarah / Carlos — thanks for the clear ask and for running the internal sync. Per the demo, I’ve drafted a compact MAP milestone focused on the technical evaluation. Attaching a one-sheet (MAP-technical-milestones-v1.xlsx) and linking a shared folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1HealthPath-Map.

Draft MAP milestone (summary):

1) Milestone: Benchmark slate & acceptance criteria
   Owner (Redwood): Karthik Iyer
   Owner (HealthPath): Carlos Mendez
   Due: 2026-03-06

2) Milestone: Environment & test-data provisioning (sample payloads, rate shaping)
   Owner (Redwood): Neha Kapoor
   Owner (HealthPath): Platform eng (TBD)
   Due: 2026-03-10

3) Milestone: Run benchmarks (latency, throughput, cost) + quality checks (prompt-suite)
   Owner (Redwood): Karthik Iyer
   Owner (HealthPath): Carlos Mendez
   Due: 2026-03-17

4) Milestone: Readout & acceptance (MAP decision: pass/fix/retest)
   Owner (Redwood): Rohan Mehta
   Owner (HealthPath): Sarah Palmer
   Due / Target close: 2026-03-24 (MAP technical milestone to be marked complete)

Dependencies & notes:
- HealthPath to provide representative sample payloads and expected QPS profile by 2026-03-03
- Access to a prod-like GPU environment or permission to run on Redwood Dedicated node (we’ll propose a reserved window)
- Test user accounts and dataset access (redacted PII) for the quality checks

Initial benchmark success criteria (proposal) — please confirm:
- Latency: p50 < 120ms, p95 < 350ms for interactive endpoints (50–512 token responses)
- Cost: average inference unit cost <= $0.0025/token under benchmarked throughput
- Quality: baseline pass-rate >= 88% on the provided prompt-suite (we’ll propose automated metric definitions and a short human review)

Proposed model shortlist to validate (we’ll tune quantization/profiles as needed):
- Mistral-7B (optimized/quantized) — strong instruction-following with low-latency profile
- Llama-2-70B (4-bit quantized variant) — high-quality candidate for complex prompts
- Falcon-40B (int8) — balanced cost/quality option

Action items for this note:
- Sarah/Carlos: confirm HealthPath owners for provisioning and whether you can supply sample payloads by 3/3
- Neha/Karthik: confirm owner level estimates and whether the latency/cost targets are achievable in a single-run benchmark or we should add a second tuning iteration

I’ve attached the MAP sheet and included the benchmark slate (benchmark-slate.json) in the Drive. If that all looks good I’ll lock owners & dates and schedule the kickoff for the week of 3/2.

Thanks — Rohan
Rohan Mehta
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Sarah Palmer <sarah.palmer@healthpath.com>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.com>
Cc: Carlos Mendez <carlos.m@healthpath.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Mar 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP: Technical evaluation milestone — benchmark slate & owners

Rohan — this is great, thanks. Carlos and I reviewed the slate and the timeline looks reasonable. A couple of asks from our side before you lock dates: 

- Please include an explicit shortlist rationale in the MAP sheet (we want 1 low-latency small model, 1 mid-sized cost-optimized model, 1 high-quality large model)
- Add p99 latency as a soft signal (we care about p95 primarily but p99 will inform tail behavior during spikes)
- Target close: HealthPath prefers the MAP technical milestone to be completed by 2026-04-15 to align with our Q2 rollout preparation — if you can note that as the contract-level MAP target we’ll align internal approvals to that date

Carlos will confirm platform owners for provisioning tomorrow. Once you incorporate those small items I’m happy to share the MAP with our platform lead.

Best,
Sarah
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Palmer <sarah.palmer@healthpath.com>, Carlos Mendez <carlos.m@healthpath.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Mar 2026 10:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP: Technical evaluation milestone — benchmark slate & owners

Thanks Rohan — I reviewed the draft and updated the acceptance criteria in the attached benchmark-slate.json. Short summary of changes / recommendations: 

- Latency targets (goal): p50 < 100ms, p95 < 300ms, p99 < 700ms (we’ll surface both median and tail for each run).
- Cost target (goal): <= $0.0019/token for the median profile when using batching/quantized runtime. We’ll report cost per 1k tokens and normalized cost-per-response for HealthPath’s sample payloads.
- Quality checks: automated prompt-suite pass-rate >= 90% (automated metrics: hit-rate on required information, hallucination rate < 5%). We will also include a 20-sample human spot-check for edge cases.
- Model shortlist (final recommended slate to include in MAP):
   * Mistral-7B (quantized runtime) — expected best latency/cost balance
   * Llama-2-70B (4-bit) — quality leader for complex instructions
   * Falcon-40B (int8) — balanced throughput candidate

I can run the initial benchmarking runs week of 3/9 if HealthPath can confirm sample payloads by 3/3 and grant the test window. Otherwise we’ll plan a short tuning iteration the following week.

I’ve attached the updated benchmark-slate.json and a small worksheet (MAP-technical-milestones-v1.xlsx) with owners/dates filled in. If everyone is aligned I’ll schedule a 30-min kickoff on Wed 3/03 10:00 AM PST to walk the engineers through the test plan.

-Neha
Neha Kapoor
Senior Engineering Manager, Performance & Benchmarks
